issues.problem: The focal route hop (workspace membership) is non-discriminating by construction: it matches every channel in T01WORKSPACE regardless of which Robert is meant, since all users including both Roberts are members of the single seeded workspace. All actual disambiguation is done by the auxiliary messages-based clause, not by the assigned route's own filter.
issues.repair: Accept as a structural/route-compliance hop (already documented in notes) or, if genuine discrimination is wanted, seed a second workspace so membership actually varies between the two Roberts.

issues.problem: The keyword 'when' is used as a coarse proxy for 'asked when X would be ready or done'; verified against the seed it produces exactly the two intended messages with no false positives, but the proxy is fragile in general (would break if any other Robert message anywhere contained 'when').
issues.repair: No change needed for this seed since verification confirms exact match; note for future seeds that keyword proxies should be checked against all messages by scoped authors, not just the intended ones.

rationale: Compilation faithfully implements the design: bindings mirror the declared roles, the mechanical query (channels→teams→user_teams→users filtered on display_name='Robert', intersected with channels→messages→users filtered on display_name='Robert' and message_text containing 'when') produces exactly the two intended channels (C01ABCD1234, C03IJKL9012) with no unintended extra matches — confirmed by manually checking every message authored by U03ROBERT23 and U_ROBERT for the 'when' substring, which yields exactly one qualifying message per user. The Nick Fury 'ready' message (C04MNOP3456) is correctly excluded by the author-identity filter alone (not even reaching the keyword check), matching the declared near-miss. mechanical_checks report no errors and computed_matches equal the two designed candidates, so no accidental extra matches or dropped alternatives exist. The remaining concerns (non-discriminating membership hop, generality of the keyword proxy) are inherited quality softness from the design stage, not compilation defects, and do not change the correctness of the constructed case.
